Commentary.Commentary: That's it then! Shakib Al Hasan is handed the trophy. Hope you enjoyed the coverage. That is it from us then, it is goodbye from here.

Shakib Al Hasan says they played really well in this series. Adds they will look to build from here for the next year's World Cup. Reckons it was a tricky wicket but Das, Shanto played well and later the bowlers stuck to their plans. Shares it was crucial to take the wicket of Malan and Jos Buttler in one over and from there on they had the momentum. Shares they are looking forward to the next challenge.

Najmul Hossain Shanto wins the Player of the Series award. He says he is happy to win the series. Adds it helps the bowlers when fielders also give their all. Hopes to continue his good performance in the upcoming series.

Litton Das wins the Player of the Match award! He says it is challenging with the new ball but things kick as the ball starts to get old. Applauds the performance of Shanto as he took away some pressure from himm.

Jos Buttler says he is disappointed to lose the series but Bangladesh did outplay them. Adds they did bowl well in the final phase to restrict them. Reckons he is disappointed with himself to get run out, he could have dived and it could have helped the team.
...Presentation time...

Since winning the first two games of the ODI series, England nose-dive and there is so much to rethink for the reigning World champions. Jos Buttler will be really disappointed as they could have at least avoided the whitewash.

The series loss had a morale effect on England and it was seen in their fielding. They though did well with the ball but it was their batting yet again that didn't help. Bangladesh have so much to take from this series. The way they batted, fielded and bowled, this will give them the utmost confidence for the upcoming series. Bangladesh looked 10-15 runs short at the start and till the halfway stage but the impact came later on as they defended the score brilliantly in the second phase. Litton Das was star with the bat and it was a collective performance with the ball.

Let me remind you, England were 100 for 1 at one stage and in full control of the game with Dawid Malan and Jos Buttler cruising through. However, Dawid Malan got out after his fifty but we feel the game turned when Jos Buttler fell in the very next delivery. That just shattered the batting line up with wickets falling one after the other. England do have a long tail but throughout this series, they have failed to create an impact.

It felt like these two were playing with the series still alive, it was that kind of game but credit to Hasan Mahmud for keeping his nerves. A series that every Bangladeshi will live in the upcoming years. They have created history.
Hasan Mahmud has done it. Bangladesh has done it! Onto the pads. Woakes fails to flick it away.
DOT! Slow again, outside off Hasan Mahmud has done a superb job. Woakes flashes and misses.
Bye! Nerves from Hasan! Full, slow and outside off. Jordon swings and misses this time. A by taken.
Bye! Full, slow and outside off, Woakes swings and misses. Jordon pushes for the single and makes his ground.
Shakib Al Hasan has a chat with Hasan Mahmud.
FOUR MORE! 19 runs needed now! Too full and outside off, Woakes squeezes it out past backward point, past the dive and into the fence.
FOUR! Is the game still open? Fuller and on off, Woakes lofts it over mid off and it bounces in front of the ropes. 23 needed now.
27 runs needed from the last over! Flat and outside  off, Jordon looks to cut but misses.
Shakib Al Hasan drags it back and serves it on middle, Woakes skips down and plays it to long on.
Another single! Flat and outside off, Jordon slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Woakes whips it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, Jordon works it to long on for a single.
OUT! Curran goes and Bangladesh are on their way to victory! Shorter, quicker and on off, Curran looks to heave but slices it high and to covers where Tanvir Islam takes a sitter.

Shorter, slower and outside off, Woakes dabs to it and misses.

Too full on off, Woakes pushes it to cover for one.
Length and on off, Curran looks to drive but inside edges it to fine leg for one.
Length and on off, defended out.
OUT! KNOCKED OVER! A beauty from Ahmed! On a length and around off. Duckett goes slightly back to push this away but misses and the ball knocks the off pole over.
Wide! A slower bumper on midde, left alone.
Ahmed serves it down leg, Curran goes back and hits it to mid-wicket for one.
Very full, outside off, Duckett works it to third man for a single.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Short and on middle. Ali pulls was a touch late and it goes off the higher part of the blade and to deep mid-wicket where Mehidy Hasan holds on it.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Slower length ball on middle, blocked out.
On a length and on off, kept out. England need 40 runs in 24 balls.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Duckett pulls it in the gap to deep mid-wicket for four runs.
On middle, Ali works it to long on for a single.
SIX! MUCH NEEDED! This is full and on middle, Ali stands tall and smacks it over long on for a six.
Close to the off pole. Ali looks to punch but misses.
Length ball, outside off, Ali swings and misses.
On the middle, defended.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on off, Duckett reverse scoops it over to third man for four.

Was that a chance? Flat and outside off, Duckett looks to push but gets an outside edge to Litton Das who first time fails to collect cleanly and fumbles it down.
Flat and on off, Duckett keeps it out.

On off, kept out.
A single as this is hit to cover.

OUT! RUN OUT! First Malan, now Buttler! Is this the game-changing moment for the home team? Length and on off, Ben Duckett taps it to point and calls for a quick single. It was straight to Mehidy Hasan who picks up and fires at the batter's end. He knew he has got his man and the replay confirms Buttler was touch short.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Mustafizur Rahman strikes! This is short and outside off, Malan takes a step across to pull but only manages a top edge as the keeper pouches it safely. 59 runs needed in 41 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Mustafizur Rahman

On middle, blocked.

Outside  off, guided through point for a single.

Angling on middle, blocked out.

On a length and outside off, probably a slower ball. Malan looks to punch but misses.

On middle, tucked to square leg for one. 13 from the over.

On a length and around off. Buttler turns it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.

That is an absolute belter from Ahmed. Malan takes a review though. This is very full and on middle, swings back onto the pads very late. Malan stays back to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. UltraEdge shows the ball takes a slight deflection off the inside edge and that saves Malan. The time Malan took to review, don't think he was aware if there was an edge.
Wide! Length ball, down leg and moves away. Malan fails to flick. Good keeping again.
Taskin Ahmed to bowl now.

OUT! STUMPED! Quick hands by Das! Tossed up, outside off, it lands and spins away. Salt looks to punch it away but misses. His back foot goes in the air and Litton Das is quick to make the most of it as he removes the bails quickly. Brilliant start by Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: st Litton Das b Tanvir Islam
